title: Scatterplot
intent: Create a Cartesian scatter plot that reveals relationships, clusters, trends, and outliers between two quantitative fields.
useWhen: Use this recipe when each row should become a point positioned by two quantitative fields.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe when one axis is categorical or when observations must be connected in an explicit order.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: An array of plain row objects containing the fields required by this task.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Task-specific field names, resource identifiers, and supported visual or statistical choices.

outcomes: Create a Cartesian scatter plot that reveals relationships, clusters, trends, and outliers between two quantitative fields.

steps.instruction: Create the data, marks, encodings, and owned resources required before authoring the scatterplot result.
Apply the primary action that produces the recognizable scatterplot result or workflow.
Add only the supporting encodings, marks, and owned resources needed for the requested scatterplot variant.

alternatives.when: Choose a neighboring recipe when its stated result and data roles match the requested chart more directly.
alternatives.instruction: Prefer one complete domain facade or task recipe before composing lower-level actions manually.

pitfalls.problem: Implicit targeting fails when several compatible datasets, marks, scales, guides, or owners exist in the same program.
pitfalls.fix: Pass the exact public identifier named by the action signature instead of relying on first-resource selection.

pitfalls.problem: Invented Canvas helpers such as renderCanvas or renderToCanvas are not package exports.
pitfalls.fix: Import { render } from "ggaction" and call render(program, context) with an existing Browser Canvas 2D context.

pitfalls.problem: SVG output does not use the root Canvas renderer or a guessed generic export function.
pitfalls.fix: Import { renderToSVG } from "ggaction/svg" and call renderToSVG(program) with the same immutable program.

pitfalls.problem: PNG output requires the Node-specific entry and an explicit filesystem destination.
pitfalls.fix: Import { renderToPNG } from "ggaction/png" and await renderToPNG(program, { output: "./chart.png", pixelRatio: 2 }).

pitfalls.problem: The PDF entry does not export renderPDF and must not rasterize or rebuild the chart.
pitfalls.fix: Import { renderToPDF } from "ggaction/pdf" and await renderToPDF(program, { output: "./chart.pdf" }).
